(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. questions.questionHtml: 61 is related to 18 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 213 is related to 38. To which of the following is 509 related, following the same logic? (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option d i.e. 66.

61 is related to 18 → 4^3 - 3 — 4^2 + 2

213 is related to 38 → 6^3 - 3 — 6^2 + 2

Similarly, 509 is related to: → 8^3 - 3 — 8^2 + 2
